# FDG9125

> CONSIDER using the Template Method Pattern to provide more controlled extensibility.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.9 Template Method.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Library only: the controlled extensibility is for subclasses outside the library (FDG9124). Not machine-checkable: whether an extensibility point should be a protected virtual member called from a nonvirtual one is a design choice. FDG6013 reports public virtual members. CA2214 (calls to virtual members from a constructor) is FDG5052's and is not about this pattern.

## From the book

In this pattern, all extensibility points are provided through protected virtual members that are called from nonvirtual members.
